purpose: Provide a transparent 0-100 capability score without confusing a composite score with mastery.

recovery.description: Ability to detect and recover from failures

efficiency.description: Cost and latency relative to target

mastery_guard: A high composite percentage cannot alone declare mastery. Required evidence remains benchmark, holdout, transfer, regression, and reproducibility appropriate to the capability.
history: Every score must be timestamped and comparable to prior versions so Buddy can measure improvement rather than only current performance.
